# About you

Merlin reads this folder before it writes anything another person will read.

- `about-me.md`: who you are, your work, and how you like to write. Merlin's about-me interview fills it in.
- `voice.md`: two or three samples of your own writing, saved word for word, plus any before-and-after edits you choose to keep. Your real writing outranks every style rule.
- `email-signature.md`: your sign-off, saved the first time you draft an email, after you say yes.

You can edit any of these by hand at any time.
